title: Golden Hour case packet v1
description: What the victim side hands to a bank's restoration / fraud-ops desk. Payment facts only: no name, PAN, Aadhaar or contact details. The SHA-256 of this JSON is shown on both sides.

held_inr.description: Amount the victim reports as held (from the police SMS); the bank checks it against its lien record

route.description: Recommended first route: report on 1930, NCRP Money Restoration request, or BNSS s.503 petition

rbi_regime.description: Which RBI customer-liability rules apply, by payment date

hold_lift.description: Only for holds up to ₹50,000; null above that (release needs an order)
